verdict.rationale: USPTO is a filing and records service with a real API surface (api.uspto.gov, developer portal), so outbound event notifications on application status are a fair thing to ask of it, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable webhooks or any outbound HTTP callback. Docketing and status tracking in Trademark Center, TSDR and Patent Center are pull-based, in-portal features and earn no credit as webhooks.
